description: Bicep template declaring a module alongside a resource
note: A template that declares a module as well as a resource -- the shape remediation-agent's Bicep structural guard has to read, since deleting a module drops a whole sub-template. checkov-only: Trivy has no Bicep scanner (multi-iac-spec §2), so a Bicep finding's self-check has one source rather than two. The mirror of OpenTofu being Trivy-only. Labelled here and said in the UI by the "checkov only" badge (dashboard/src/review/coverage.ts), not left to be discovered.
